title: Y Combinator Scraper
description: Extract YC-funded companies, founders, and open jobs from ycombinator.com/companies. Use the guided filters below for the most common cases, or paste full directory URLs to use any filter combination YC supports.

startUrls.title: YC Directory or Company URLs
startUrls.description: Paste one or more Y Combinator URLs. Accepts directory pages with filters pre-applied (e.g. https://www.ycombinator.com/companies?batch=W24&industry=B2B), individual company URLs (https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/airbnb), or a mix. Leave empty to use the guided filters below — or to scrape the full unfiltered directory if no filters are set.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Pick any combination of YC URLs and guided filters. Leave everything blank to scrape the entire directory (capped by Max Results).

searchQuery.title: Search Query
searchQuery.description: Optional free-text search across the YC directory (matches the search box on ycombinator.com/companies). Combines with the filters below.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Narrow the directory by batch, status, region, industry, team size, or hiring activity. All filters are optional. Ignored when you paste Start URLs above (the URL already specifies the filters).

batches.title: YC Batches
batches.description: Funding cohorts to include. Multi-select. Leave empty to include all batches.

status.title: Company Status
status.description: Operating status. Multi-select. Leave empty for all statuses.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Headquarters region. Multi-select. Leave empty for all regions.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Industry vertical. Multi-select. Leave empty for all industries.

teamSize.title: Team Size
teamSize.description: Self-reported employee count. Multi-select. Leave empty for any size.

isHiring.title: Hiring Only
isHiring.description: If on, return only companies with at least one open job listed on YC. Useful for recruiting and lead generation.

includeFounders.title: Include Founders
includeFounders.description: Embed each company's founders on the result row — name, title, bio, LinkedIn, and X. Disable for faster, cheaper runs that return only company-level data. (Note: Y Combinator does not publish founder emails publicly — `email` and `emailStatus` are always null.)
includeFounders.sectionDescription: Control how much detail to capture per company. Each result is one company row regardless of these toggles — founders and jobs ride along as nested arrays.

includeJobs.title: Include Open Jobs
includeJobs.description: Embed each company's open job listings on the result row — title, location, remote, salary, equity, required skills, years of experience, and visa sponsorship. Disable when you only need company and founder data. (Tip: turn off both Founders and Jobs for the fastest, cheapest runs — only company-level fields are returned.)

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on total company rows. Default 100 — increase for bigger runs, or set to 0 for no cap (an internal upper limit of 10,000 still applies to prevent runaway pagination). The actor stops requesting new pages once this number is reached but keeps the full final page even if it slightly overshoots.
maxResults.sectionDescription: Cap how many companies to collect.
